Selected funerary-mask representation keeps the two unequal forehead emblem projections and their base seams, nemes exterior and two descending lappets, face boundary, both inlay eyes and pupil outlines with brows, nose, lips, attached false beard and broad collar. Eyes and pupils are independently enlarged, the three sparse bands on each lappet are 13 mm lines, and small emblem necks are widened. Pattern lines remain introduced sparse cues, not an exact stripe count or artifact measurement. This represents metal/inlay artifact regions rather than living skin or hair. Pattern lines remain introduced sparse cues, not an exact stripe count or artifact measurement. This represents metal/inlay artifact regions rather than living skin or hair.
